svg.aria-label: URL shortening flow with base 62: take the long URL and check whether it is already in the database. If yes, return the stored short URL. If no, get a new unique ID from the ID generator (for example 3141592653589), base-62 encode it into 7 characters (TjbIC7r), save the row (id, shortURL, longURL) and return the short URL.
svg.title: URL shortening flow
